text:
Rae: Quick brief spectrum-12b quant tests on multi-paragraph summaries (avg output ~900 toks). We compared int6 vs int8. Need routing recs.

Micah: Numbers and sample size?

Rae: 1,200 examples, human spot n=180. eval-bot table below.

eval-bot: |metric|int6|int8|delta|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|ROUGE-L|43.0|39.4|-3.6|
|BLEU|12.0|10.4|-1.6|
|Hallucination|4.2%|7.1%|+2.9pp|
|Cost/1k|$0.119|$0.078|-34%|

Jo: Unit econ ~34% savings. For 800k tokens/day that's ~ $27k/mo. But tail hallucination uptick on >700 token outputs is concerning.

Micah: Latency? int8 p50 ~8% faster, p95 similar. So cost dominates.

Rae: My rec: default to int8, but route expected_output>700 OR slice==multi-paragraph to int6. Start with 5% GTN canary -> 20% holdback. Fallback immediate to int6 if hallucination > baseline +1pp over 3h.

Jo: +1. Also add ngram-repetition monitor and a human NPS check on the holdback.

Micah: Make sure to save counterexamples and shadow fp16 for VIPs.

Rae: I'll file the scorecard (slices: multi-paragraph, instruction-heavy, citation-required) and schedule staging rollout flag: spectrum-12b-routing-v1.
